name: Build a Bridge for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Build a Bridge for Brainrots!

🏃 Run fast. Build bridges. Collect brainrots.

💰 Collect Brainrots to earn cash
🔨 Build bridges to reach BETTER Brainrot zones
👟 Buy more speed to move faster
🚧 Upgrade Brainrots to earn more money
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more slots

💤 Brainrots keep earning cash OFFLINE!

[❤️] Like the game and join the group to support!
